questions.question: A ladder 5 m long slides down a wall. When the bottom is 3 m from the wall and moving at 1 m/s, how fast is the top sliding down?
questions.explanation: x² + y² = 25. Differentiating: 2x(dx/dt) + 2y(dy/dt) = 0. When x=3, y=4: 2(3)(1) + 2(4)(dy/dt) = 0, so dy/dt = -6/8 = -3/4 m/s. Speed = 3/4 m/s.

The integrating factor of the differential equation dy/dx + (2/x)y = x² is:
questions.explanation: For dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x), integrating factor = e^(∫P(x)dx). Here P(x) = 2/x, so IF = e^(∫2/x dx) = e^(2ln|x|) = e^(ln x²) = x².

questions.question: The function f(x) = x³ - 3x² is increasing on which interval?
questions.explanation: f'(x) = 3x² - 6x = 3x(x-2). f'(x) > 0 when x < 0 or x > 2. So f is increasing on (-∞,0) ∪ (2,∞).

questions.question: If A is a square matrix satisfying A² = A + I, then A⁵ equals:
questions.explanation: A² = A + I. A³ = A·A² = A(A+I) = A² + A = 2A + I. A⁴ = A·A³ = A(2A+I) = 2A² + A = 3A + 2I. A⁵ = A·A⁴ = A(3A+2I) = 3A² + 2A = 5A + 3I.

questions.question: Evaluate ∫₀^π x·sin x dx.

questions.explanation: Separating variables: dy/y = -2dx. Integrating: ln|y| = -2x + C₁, so y = Ce^(-2x). Using y(0)=3: C=3. So y = 3e^(-2x). At x=1: y(1) = 3e⁻².

questions.question: The maximum volume of a cylinder inscribed in a sphere of radius R is:
questions.explanation: Let cylinder have radius r and height h. From geometry: r² + (h/2)² = R². Volume V = πr²h = π(R² - h²/4)h = π(R²h - h³/4). dV/dh = π(R² - 3h²/4) = 0 → h = 2R/√3. Then r² = R² - R²/3 = 2R²/3. V = π(2R²/3)(2R/√3) = 4πR³/(3√3).
